tags.title: Goodbye to Friends
tags.comments:
One thing in games I cherish is the afterward.  I want to remember the game, I don't know how to say it, almost secluded all by itself in it's own little world, not knowing anything beyond, not swayed by anything from outside this little world;  I want the game to be itself a mystery, an unknown, striving to tell me about itself.

Anyway, this is an old song I made.
